name: tpl
reason: No numbers anywhere reachable. README is two lines; doc/index.html says only 'Efficient serialization in C'; doc/userguide.txt, examples.txt, ChangeLog.txt and tests/ (125 tests plus tests/other) hold no benchmark or msgpack comparison. A WebSearch for tpl vs msgpack found no third-party numbers. Docs site troydhanson.github.io/tpl is blocked here but the same docs are in the repo's doc/ directory. Repo archived 2025-11-29, 383 stars.

name: tree.hh
listed_description: An STL-like C++ header-only tree library.
reason: No benchmark or std::map comparison in README.rst, doc/main.md, doc/tree.tex, doc/index.html, doc/documentation.html or ChangeLog. It is an n-ary tree container, not an ordered map, so std::map is not a natural baseline. No third-party shootout found. GPL-2.0/3.0, 156 stars, last commit 2024-07-19.

name: Tulip Indicators
listed_description: Library of functions for technical analysis of financial data.
reason: Lead worth a retry from an unrestricted network. Repo has benchmark.c, a harness that times each indicator against TA-Lib when built with -DTA_LIB (make benchmark_talib; generated results go to docs/benchmark.php), and the README says 'Uses fast algorithms', but the repo holds no result numbers. The results page lives on tulipindicators.org (benchmark page), which is EGRESS_BLOCKED here, so no numbers were read. LGPL-3.0, 943 stars, last commit 2024-01-08. Baseline would be TA-Lib.

name: uClibc-ng
listed_description: ) - Small C library for developing embedded systems.
reason: Project claim is small size, not speed ('much smaller than the GNU C Library'); the GitHub mirror README and description have no benchmark or numbers, and uclibc-ng.org is EGRESS_BLOCKED. Listed URL https://uclibc-ng.org/. Guessed category sequence-containers is wrong (it is a libc, libc-replacement). LGPL-2.1, 215 stars.

name: upb
listed_description: A small protobuf implementation in C.
reason: Speed claim is directional only: README says 'comparable speed to protobuf C++, but is an order of magnitude smaller in code size'; the wiki says it parses 'at roughly the same speed' as built-in C++ parsers. The only numbers found are code size, in archive/docs/vs-cpp-protos.md: .text 26Ki for upb vs 187Ki for C++ lite and 983Ki for C++ full (trivial parse and serialize of descriptor.proto), which is not a speed win. archive/benchmarks/ (benchmark.cc, compare.py, google/benchmark with bytes-per-second counters) is public but no result numbers are published in the repo; the 2021 tail-call blog post with GB/s numbers (blog.reverberate.org) is EGRESS_BLOCKED. Repo archived 2025-12-09, development moved to protocolbuffers/protobuf/upb; 1.5k stars. Retry candidate if numbers on the blog or in upb commit messages become reachable.

name: utf8proc
reason: No win found. bench/ holds bench.c, icu.c and unistring.c harnesses (eprun Deutsch/Japanese/Korean/Vietnamese files, NFKC, -O2) but the repo publishes no results. Search snippet of issue #12 (page comments not rendered by WebFetch) reports utf8proc slower than ICU: Deutsch_.txt 0.0039 s vs 0.000112 s, Japanese_.txt 0.0046 s vs 0.00027 s (ICU given a preallocated buffer). No libunistring numbers reachable. MIT, 1.3k stars. Snippet-only, so no record.
